<div class="media-box media-{{{kind|image}}}" id="{{{id|}}}"><div class="media-file">{{#switch:{{{kind|image}}}|video=Video|diagram=Diagram|#default=Figure}}: <code>{{{file}}}</code>, shown in the edition</div><div class="media-caption">{{{caption|}}}</div>{{#if:{{{record|}}}|<div class="media-record">[[Numerical methods#{{{record}}}|How this was made]]</div>}}</div><noinclude>
A picture, a video or a diagram. The file is kept in the folder wiki/media of the project (later, uploaded to the wiki); the edition shows it, the wiki shows this box. Parameters: kind (image, video or diagram), file, caption, record (the anchor of its record on [[Numerical methods]], for computed pictures and videos), poster (for a video: the still image shown before it plays), id (an anchor). Write the call on one line.</noinclude>
